claims.text: Typo in variable name 'groupUuuids' - has three 'u's instead of two, should be 'groupUuids'
Set the stop flag from a `finally` block; otherwise a failed delete leaves the polling thread running indefinitely.
The test polls groups(null, 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, true), requesting the entire realm's groups on every poll — unnecessary load in CI.

GroupUtils.populateGroupHierarchyFromSubGroups() dereferences parentModel (from session.groups().getGroupById(realm, currGroup.getParentId())) without a null check, so the exact same concurrent-deletion race this PR fixes elsewhere still NPEs here — hit via GET admin/realms/{realm}/groups with populateHierarchy=true (the default) whenever a returned group has a parent, and not covered by the new test since it only creates top-level groups.
A newly added blank line has trailing whitespace (4 trailing spaces).

Could the 100 'Test Group N' groups created by this test leak into and affect other test methods in the same GroupTest class if the delete loop fails partway (per F-004), depending on whether @InjectRealm's lifecycle is per-class or per-method and whether tests run in parallel?
getSubGroupsStream(...) overloads at lines 256/262/268 use modelSupplier.get() without null checks and are susceptible to the same race condition NPE

The delete loop that precedes deletedAll.set(true) has no try/finally, so if any remove() call throws, deletedAll stays false forever and the non-daemon reader thread loops indefinitely hitting the server, blocking JVM shutdown and potentially affecting other tests in the class.

The new test's assertion only checks that no exception was caught and discards the returned List<GroupRepresentation> entirely, so a failure can't be distinguished from any other 500 error, and the fix's actual behavior (subGroupCount handling) is never verified against real response content.

The three getSubGroupsStream() overloads in the same GroupAdapter class (lines 256/262/268) are still unprotected calls to modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) and will NPE under the same concurrent-group-deletion race this PR fixes for getSubGroupsCount() — e.g. GET admin/realms/{realm}/groups/{group-id}/children still returns 500 in that race.
The reader thread isn’t waited for; flipping deletedAll to true and asserting immediately can race and miss exceptions added just after the flag change, making this test flaky.
Three getSubGroupsStream overloads in GroupAdapter (lines 254-268) have the same unguarded modelSupplier.get() pattern and will still NPE under concurrent deletion - the fix is incomplete

The PR bundles two changes unrelated to the NPE fix: adding @Override to CachedGroup.getRealm(), and removing the now-unused private static groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement from GroupUtils — both are safe on their own, but PR-CHECKLIST.md requires PRs not contain changes unrelated to the GitHub issue, and mixing them in makes future git-blame archaeology on this fix noisier.

Does createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti actually reproduce the original NPE reliably in CI, or could it pass whether or not the fix is applied, since it has no synchronization point guaranteeing the reader thread's request lands in the cache-stale/DB-deleted window?
Returning null from getSubGroupsCount() violates the GroupModel contract (Javadoc says it never returns null) and may lead to NPEs in callers that expect a non-null count.
The variable name groupUuuids (three u's) is a typo, used at three call sites in the new test.
